PLAN · 1:10
Every bay is flat. The came at each joint
takes the angle — no glass is bent.
AXONOMETRIC
FROM THE BED SIDE
ALL GLASS. One composition across the whole wall — the border runs straight through the bay joints.
Border: an outer rectangle 150 in from every edge and an inner one 420 in at the sides, 460 at head and foot,
joined by a short bar at the middle of each side, with a cross at each corner of the inner rectangle.
Within it, each bay carries a tiered head and foot, a stem into the field, and three crosses down each margin.
White textured glass in lead came. No colour. The television is shown for position only — how it is carried is not drawn.
